CA.quote: are held and firmly bound to the People of the State of California in the penal sum of FIFTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($50,000)
CA.note: Continuous bond on DMV form OL 25; a cash deposit (OL 25E) can replace it. Wholesale-only dealers selling fewer than 25 vehicles a year can claim an exemption (OL 56).

TX.quote: all new and renewal GDN license applications must be submitted with a $50,000 Motor Vehicle Dealer Surety Bond
TX.note: Independent GDN dealers since September 1, 2021. Franchised dealers and trailer-only GDNs are exempt. The bond runs two years with the license.

FL.quote: a good and sufficient surety bond or irrevocable letter of credit, executed by the applicant-dealer as principal, in the sum of $25,000
FL.note: Filed on FLHSMV form HSMV 86020 in the exact state wording; a $25,000 letter of credit from a Florida bank can replace it.

GA.note: Used motor vehicle dealers; a separate bond for each licensed location, expiring September 30 of even-numbered years. Parts dealers need $10,000.

NC.quote: fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) for one established salesroom
NC.note: $25,000 more for each additional established salesroom. Form LT-409 (surety) or LT-408 (cash bond).

IL.quote: original $50,000 Illinois vehicle dealer's bond or certificate of deposit
IL.note: Per location, for new and used dealers; the bond must run at least to December 31 of the license year.

NY.quote: $100,000 – Retail or Wholesale Motor Vehicle Dealer (other than New) that sold more than 50 vehicles during the previous calendar year
NY.note: The amount depends on the dealer type and last year's sales. Dealers of trailers, motorcycles, vehicles over 10,000 lb, ATVs, boats and snowmobiles are exempt.

variants.label: Used or wholesale dealer, 50 or fewer sales last year
Used or wholesale dealer, more than 50 sales last year

VA.quote: the applicant must file a $50,000 bond with the Board
VA.note: Required for the first three consecutive years of operation; a lapse restarts the count. Claims above the bond go to the Motor Vehicle Transaction Recovery Fund.

WA.quote: a surety bond in the amount of: (a) For motor vehicle dealers, thirty thousand dollars
WA.note: One bond per business location; miscellaneous dealers need $5,000.
